replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design has repo file reading plus comment posting on fork PRs; concrete exfiltration path."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"Diff fed to LLM, fork-authored, bot can approve/merge; concrete injection-to-approval attack."},{"id":"T3","keep":false,"reason":"Same attack and harm as T2: injected/misjudged fork PR gains approval and merge of malicious code.","duplicateOf":"T2"},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Every PR triggers LLM review and forks are open to anyone; cost/queue exhaustion is supported."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Design states token can approve and merge; over-privileged credential compromise distinct from injection path."},{"id":"T6","keep":true,"reason":"Bot reads repository files every review; persistent poisoning of future reviews is a distinct attack."}]}
